format.name: blanko.project
format.container: uncompressed JSON envelope + JSON payload/base64 originals
format.checksums: CRC32 envelope and originals; corruption detection, not authenticity
format.limits: 64MiB file;32MiB total originals;16MiB each;64M original pixels; built-in editor fonts only
format.importSafety: validate codec/geometry/references/checksums/decoded dimensions before new assets/board; fresh independent boardId and remapped asset IDs; no current-board overwrite or lastBoard mutation on validation failure
format.compatibility: old local schema1 Frame records read with absent optional outputWidth/outputHeight; new fields strictly rejected by old readers; unknown portable versions/custom fonts/SHA256 declarations rejected explicitly

limitations: PNG <=8192side and16000000pixels,96MiB retained decoded originals; Web original decode/CPU transfer/GPU/output peak memory unmeasured
file gateways available macOS/Web only; Windows/Android/iOS/Edge/Safari full file qualification pending
failed staged import can leave unattached originals; no asset GC
arbitrary selection/custom-area export outside Frames, custom font packaging, future migrations and device peak-time/memory qualification remain backlog
Undo/Redo remains session-only; no full regression suite or benchmark loop repeated
manualSteps: More tools > Frame or Export frame, draw; Select the border > Frame properties. Set label, canvas size and export pixels. Select artwork > Place in frame; move the parent and verify child follows. Resize parent and verify child stays in world position. Undo/Redo. Wait Saved locally then restart/reload and reopen.

Files & export > Export PNG; choose viewport or named ExportFrame, transparency/solid and HD/4K/custom. Save native panel or check browser Downloads. Open actual PNG and verify clipping/artwork without handles.

Files & export > Save As .wboard, then Import .wboard. Verify a separate local board with original image pixels. Alter imported copy; original board remains independent. Corrupt/unsupported input must show error and retain current board.
